features.title: New Rivian Assistant
features.description: Use the AI-powered, in-vehicle Rivian Assistant to help with the following: Control vehicle settings, climate control, navigation, media, messaging and calling. Reference the Owner's Guide with your voice. Answer general knowledge or follow-up questions. You can ask about local restaurants, the weather at your destination, or the song that was just played. Explain in-vehicle alerts or notifications or walk you through troubleshooting steps for vehicle concerns. How to Use To use Rivian Assistant, complete the first-time setup on the center display. To activate Rivian Assistant, use one of these methods: Long-press the left thumbwheel on the steering wheel. Tap Rivian Assistant in the status bar on the center display. Say " Okay, Rivian " or “ Hey, Rivian .” To stop a command or interaction, press the left thumbwheel or tap the Rivian Assistant wave graphic on the center display. To learn more about Rivian Assistant, ask it about what it can do. To opt out or deactivate the wake words, go to Settings > Apps > Rivian Assistant on the center display. For more information, go to the Owner's Guide and search for Rivian Assistant . How to Personalize In the Rivian mobile app version 3.12 or later, you can personalize your Rivian Assistant experience through Rivian Intelligence. Go to Account > Rivian Intelligence to turn on these features: Google Calendar: Connect your calendar so you can create, re-schedule, or navigate to events using Rivian Assistant. Memory: Rivian Assistant learns your preferences over time, such as favorite music genres, restaurants, and regular destinations, including work or school drop-off locations. You can turn off Memory or delete the stored details at any time. NOTES The mobile app saves the Rivian Intelligence settings to your driver profile and applies them to any Rivian vehicle you drive. Rivian Assistant is available on vehicles that are actively subscribed to Connect+ or are in a trial period. Rivian Assistant is only available in English. Google Calendar and Memory are turned off by default. Opt in to use these features. When you turn on Rivian Assistant, your vehicle automatically turns off Alexa and all Alexa integrations.

features.title: Secure Your Profile

To set this up, go to Profile > Account > Security > Profile PIN in the Rivian mobile app version 3.12 or later. NOTE If the Profile authentication feature is turned on, the following apply: The vehicle authenticates you and your profile only if it detects a digital or phone key. If it doesn't detect a key, the center display prompts you to enter a PIN. The Profile PIN applies to all Rivian vehicles that you own or drive. When the profile is locked, you have limited access to vehicle features until you authenticate.

features.description: - Added a new Streaming Quality setting. Enabled by default, this setting reduces buffering by automatically adjusting audio quality depending on connectivity speeds. To always play the highest quality audio available, turn this setting off. - Increased the maximum number of playlists and albums accessible from Artist screens. - Added support for Dolby Audio content. - Improved general stability and performance.

features.title: Autonomy
features.description: - Fixed an issue that caused the vehicle to immediately reject Lane Change on Command after a previous lane change. - Updated the in-vehicle messaging for unsuccessful Universal Hands-Free engagement requests when turn signals are active or hands are off the steering wheel.

features.title: Power and Battery
features.description: - Improved the accuracy of vehicle diagnostics to better protect 12 V battery health. - Improved system reliability to protect from a very rare electronic park braking fault after vehicle wake. - Fixed an issue that could slowly cause usable battery range to fluctuate. Range estimates now behave more consistently.

features.title: Other Improvements
features.description: - Turning on Rear Defrost now also turns on the front wiper heating element in the windshield. (Gen 1 and Gen 2) - Improved capacity management of the 12 V battery system. (Gen 1 only) - Fixed an issue that caused persistent digital key passive unlock and vehicle start failures. (Gen 2 only) - Fixed a rare issue that caused the charge port door to stick after water ingress. (Gen 2 only) - Fixed a rare issue that caused the trip meter gauge to display a much higher energy consumption value than the actual. (Gen 2 only)

features.title: New Driver Assistance Features: Smart Turn Signal and Go Chime
features.description: - The turn signal now automatically turns off after you perform a manual lane change on a highway. - While you’re at a stop, Go Chime alerts you when the vehicle ahead of you drives away. Go Chime is turned on by default. To turn off Go Chime, go to Settings > Vehicle > Driver Assistance on the center display.

features.title: Gear Guard Enhancement
features.description: With Motion Cam enabled in the Gear Guard app, it starts recording video when it detects people close to the vehicle. With this enhancement, Motion Cam now also starts recording when it detects objects nearby. NOTE : This feature is subject to limitations. It may not capture all events, may generate false positives, and video quality may not guarantee vehicle or individual identification. This feature is intended to provide supplemental information and should not be solely relied upon for legal purposes.

features.title: Ride Comfort Improvements
features.description: For a smoother ride experience, we significantly diminished vehicle rocking while driving diagonally over speed bumps, entering and exiting parking lot entrances, and driving over other types of asymmetric bumps and dips at low speeds.

features.title: Additional Improvements for Gen 1 & 2
features.description: Enhanced Alexa integration - Added direct SiriusXM channel playback by name or number. - Improved YouTubeTM search and playback functionality, including direct media control when YouTube is active. Other Improvements - Added SiriusXM® dual-stream support in live sports games. - Added the ability to scroll through larger Apple Music playlists. - Significantly improved system responsiveness and reliability. - Fixed an issue that prevented Wi-Fi® from self-recovering without resetting the infotainment system. - Fixed an issue that prevented the clock time on the rear display from updating until the screen was unlocked. - Reduced Level 2 charging time in below freezing temperatures. - Added notifications for critically low tire pressures.

features.title: Additional Improvements for Gen 1
features.description: - Fixed a rare issue that prevented glass in the side mirrors from automatically reaching tilt or drive positions. - l Fixed a rare issue that caused a “set up phone key” pop-up to falsely appear for active phone keys.

features.title: Additional Improvements for Gen 2
features.description: - Reduced the intrusiveness of unbuckled occupant notifications. - Improved vehicle wake responsiveness when the vehicle is not in its assigned Home location. - Reduced vehicle range loss in some cases when the 12 V battery has a low state of health. - Improved the response time of phone key lock and unlock. - Reduced vehicle energy use in certain situations when a key fob or phone key is left near the vehicle. - Fixed an issue that would disable AndroidTM phone key functionality and require re-pairing. - Fixed a rare issue that prevented a phone key from successfully pairing with a vehicle. - Fixed a rare issue that caused vehicle cabin heating to stop when the vehicle exited a warm garage in cold weather. - Reduced the intrusiveness of unbuckled occupant notifications.

features.title: New Feature in Spotify
features.description: Spotify® now offers DJ, an AI-based guide that can play songs recommended for you and commentary about the artists and their music. We've also made general performance improvements for a better listening experience. To activate DJ, go to Media > Spotify and choose DJ. When the DJ playlist is active, you can choose DJ on the media panel to play a different set of songs.

features.title: Data Updates for Driver Assistance Features
features.description: We've improved driver assistance data updates, so the vehicle receives the latest status of highway or road construction, updates of certain speed limits, and other data to optimize availability and safety of Highway Assist and other driver assistance features. For your vehicle to automatically receive updates, connect your vehicle to Wi-Fi. After your vehicle receives an update, it automatically applies the update in the background, so you can drive the vehicle and use driver assistance features. To view the progress of a data update, go to the quick control Vehicle > Shortcuts > Updates on the center display. NOTES - If the vehicle isn’t connected to Wi-Fi when an update is available, the vehicle notifies you on the center display. - If highways undergo or finish construction, this may affect the availability of Highway Assist and other driver assistance features.

features.title: Additional Improvements (Gen 1 & Gen 2)
features.description: Media - Recent searches for Apple Music and Spotify are now saved when you switch driver profiles or media sources. - Fixed an issue with account authentication in Apple Music. Other Improvements - Fixed an issue that affected the volume control for Alexa. - Improved the transition from Wi-Fi® to cellular connectivity as you drive away from a Wi-Fi network. - Fixed an issue that misaligned the vehicle image with the quick controls. features.title: Additional Improvements (Gen 2)
features.description: On Tri-Motor vehicles, we’ve updated the following drive mode behavior: - If you disable the Auto setting for Ride Height and the vehicle sleeps, the Auto setting now remains disabled after it wakes. - If the vehicle sleeps while in Sport mode, it now remains in Sport mode after it wakes. features.title: Vehicle Alarm Improvement
features.description: After the vehicle alarm is triggered, the in-vehicle displays are unavailable. If the vehicle detects your presence, the center display now describes how to disable the alarm and wake the displays.

features.title: Charging, Efficiency, and Thermal Improvements
features.description: Improved the charging efficiency of Dual-Motor Large and Max pack batteries. Improved drive efficiency in mild to cold ambient temperature conditions. In certain cold conditions, a small section of the front fascia now heats to ensure sensor performance. Extended the defrost time during vehicle preconditioning (set through the Rivian mobile app) to more effectively melt ice and snow off of the windshield.

features.title: Vehicle Sleep Improvements
features.description: Improved the “Ready” state efficiency when there is no driver present. If a charger is not properly or only partially plugged in, the vehicle now sleeps after 60 seconds. Updated vehicle behavior to allow it to sleep even if the driver seat belt is buckled. To keep the vehicle awake for a long period of time, use one of the options below. See the Owner's Guide for more information. Go to Camping > Manage energy and choose Stay on. Go to Camping > Outlets and set the Timer. Go to Settings > Vehicle > Service and turn on Show and Tell.

features.title: Apple Music Improvements
features.description: Fixed an issue that caused perceived volume to fluctuate between tracks, particularly when moving between Dolby Atmos and stereo. Fixed a rare playback issue that prevented songs from playing. Fixed an issue that prevented the See All button from working for some Live Radio entries. Added day and night modes for settings and sign-in pages on the center display.

features.title: Infotainment Improvements
features.description: Fixed a rare issue that caused the infotainment system to reboot while streaming a video to the center display via Google Cast. (2nd Gen Only) Fixed an issue that caused the rear display to not respond to touch in some cases after attempting to transition the screen to the home page. (2nd Gen Only) Enhanced overall infotainment system performance and stability, and addressed issues that caused unexpected resets.

features.title: Additional Improvements
features.description: Improved the drivability and control of the vehicle in R (Reverse). On Dual-Motor vehicles, fixed a rare issue that caused the vehicle to get stuck in Conserve mode on vehicles that don’t have Conserve mode. Fixed an issue that prevented the Day/Night lock sound setting from working correctly until the vehicle GPS position was restored during wake. (1st Gen Only) Fixed an issue that caused passenger windows to falsely detect obstructions during auto up or down. (2nd Gen Only) The Rivian mobile app version 2.18.0 or later now includes the ability to add third-row seat heating to climate schedules. (2nd Gen Only) Navigation favorites—Work, saved locations, and recent destinations—are now saved to your individual driver profile. You can also access these locations when planning trips in the Rivian mobile app version 2.18 or later. Fixed a rare issue on a small number of vehicles that blocked all remote (cloud) commands from the Rivian mobile app. This fix requires affected drivers to delete all paired phone keys and re-pair them to restore functionality.

features.title: Driver Display Improvements
features.description: We improved the appearance and usability of the driver display. - Added a new navigation maneuver panel in the top left. - Consolidated most of the driver notifications to the left side, and added new animations. - Improved the volume, headlight, and wiper notifications. - Improved the energy graph and Tire Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS) carousel panels. - Added a new phone and media panel to the carousel.

features.title: Rivian Autonomy Platform Improvements
features.description: - Our new Model Predictive Controller (MPC) improves steering comfort in Highway Assist by providing much smoother and more natural transitions when centering in or changing lanes. - We improved vehicle detection and visualization on the driver display.

features.title: Automatic Front Camera in Park Assist
features.description: When Park Assist engages, the front camera view now automatically appears on the center display. This helps you to navigate tight parking spaces more confidently without taking your hands off the wheel. The setting is enabled by default. Go to Settings > Driver Assistance > Automatic Parking Camera to disable it.

features.title: Gear Guard Live Cam
features.description: Gear Guard Live Cam allows you to view live video streams from the Gear Guard cameras on your Rivian mobile app (version 2.14.0 or later). You can initiate Live Cam while the vehicle is parked. You can check on the vehicle spontaneously, or in response to a notification from the Gear Guard alarm system. Use the Rivian mobile app to: - View live camera feeds when the vehicle is in Park. - Receive notifications and review camera feeds when the alarm is triggered. - Switch between camera feeds for any of the Gear Guard cameras. NOTE Gear Guard Live Cam requires you to have a Connect+ subscription and to opt into precise location sharing with the Rivian mobile app. Running a virtual private network (VPN) client on your mobile device may prevent your ability to view live camera feeds.

features.title: Tri-Zone Climate
features.description: Your vehicle now provides three distinct climate zones: driver seat, front passenger seat, and rear passenger seats. Each is customizable, making every trip more comfortable. You can now: - Heat the rear seats from the Vent Controls panel by selecting the graphic of the seat you want to heat. - Manage the temperature settings for all three zones using the Climate Controls panel on the center display. - View and adjust the temperature setting for the rear zone through the rear display.

features.title: Enhanced Seat Belt Reminder for the Second and Third Rows
features.description: To comply with the latest Insurance Institute of Highway Safety (IIHS) standards, we’ve made several improvements to the seat belt reminder notification system. - Until seat belts are fastened, auditory and visual alerts persist to remind passengers in all seats to fasten their seat belts. - On the Driver display, a status indicator shows the status for all seats (occupied/unoccupied) and seat belts (fastened/not fastened) so you can quickly and easily identify which is triggering the alert.

features.title: Enhanced Seat Belt Reminder for the Rear Row
features.description: To comply with the latest Insurance Institute of Highway Safety (IIHS) standards, we’ve made several improvements to the seat belt reminder notification system. - Until seat belts are fastened, auditory and visual alerts persist to remind passengers in all seats to fasten their seat belts. - On the Driver display, a status indicator shows the status for all seats (occupied/unoccupied) and seat belts (fastened/not fastened) so you can quickly and easily identify which is triggering the alert.

features.title: New Animations for Drive Mode Settings
features.description: We’ve added new animations to help you better understand the changes you make to the Ride Height, Brake Regen, Stability, and Ride Feel settings. When you update a setting, an animation shows you helpful visual information about the settings you are changing and how it affects your vehicle. - The Ride Height animation shows the ground and overhead clearance of the vehicle at different ride heights. - The Ride Feel settings animation shows how the vehicle responds to the terrain it is traveling over. - Stability settings visualization displays information about how much the vehicle is allowed to slip from the intended path.

features.title: Enhanced Dynamic Lighting
features.description: Vehicle headlights now automatically adjust depending on real-time road and vehicle conditions. We have made several improvements to your vehicle’s dynamic lighting: - The headlight beams adjust dynamically and automatically so the road is optimally lit, regardless of ride height or road conditions. - Driver visibility is improved, reducing glare for oncoming traffic and improving overall road safety. - The headlights respond to changes in your vehicle’s pitch and weight distribution so they can keep the beams level for optimal aim.

features.title: Additional Improvements
features.description: For Gen 2- Model Year 2025 Dual Standard vehicles: - Improved range accuracy where the range may re-calibrate after a software update for affected vehicles. - The vehicle now more accurately detects when the battery is fully charged. - Improved notifications when the battery is calibrating before reaching 100%. - Improved charging time estimation. Smoother and more natural speed control while in Adaptive Cruise Control or Highway Assist including (Gen 2 Only): - Quicker following behavior when accelerating from a stop at an intersection. - Smoother performance in stop-and-go traffic. - More predictive and intelligent acceleration behavior at highway speeds. - More accurate gap distance following behavior. Improved locking and unlocking functionality (Gen 2 Only): - If a passenger uses the rear display to unlock the vehicle while it isn’t parked, the vehicle now relocks itself after three seconds. - When the vehicle travels above 2 mph (3 km/h) the lock and unlock control isn’t available on the rear display. - When the vehicle travels above 7 mph (10 km/h) the lock and unlock control isn’t available on the center display. - Fixed a rare issue that caused the vehicle to proximity lock when a phone was on the center console. - Resolved a rare issue in which proximity locks were triggered by a paired phone disconnection despite the key not being near the vehicle. - Disabling the global proximity lock/unlock settings now also disabled press to unlock. - Improved press to unlock functionality to reduce the chance of unexpected unlock events. - Improved press to unlock sensor detection. Apple Music improvements - Fixed an issue that prevented Apple Music from resuming following a wake from sleep. - The Explicit icon is now displayed in Show More view and Artist view. - A subtitle for content is now displayed in Show More and Artist view. - Fixed an issue that displayed an incorrect message of “no media here” as you typed in the Search bar. - Added a message to indicate that no content was found if there are no results for a search. Other - Fixed a rare USB disconnect issue on the front USB-C outlets. (Gen 2 Only) - Fixed a rare issue causing disconnects of the USB drive, which disabled Drive Cam features that use a USB storage device and prevented charging from USB outlets in the vehicle. (Gen 2 Only) - Fixed a rare issue that caused the vehicle displays to lag when a USB drive was connected. - Fixed a rare issue that prevented video files from Motion Cam, Alarms, Gear Guard, and Incident Cam from displaying. - Resolved an issue that caused the vehicle to enter Limited Performance Mode and display incorrect Driver Assistance notifications on the driver display when the vehicle shifted into Drive. (Gen 2 Only) - Updated volume settings for better level adjustments on Meridian Audio systems. (Gen 1 Only) - Fixed an issue that displayed an incorrect “No media available here” message in media apps when shifting gears. - Fixed an issue that prevented some vehicles from playing audio after vehicle sleep or a software update unless you adjusted the volume using the left thumbwheel or the center display. (Gen 1 Only) - Improved vehicle wake up behavior to reduce the time required to drive off. (Gen 2 Only) - Fixed an issue that mistakenly displayed a payment error message on the center display after the successful start of an AC charging session. - Fixed an issue that incorrectly displayed the garage door opener prompt when the vehicle isn’t near that garage door. - Fixed an issue that displayed the incorrect number of 12 V outlets on the 12 V outlet graphic of certain vehicles. - Added a chime warning to notify you of objects next to the sides of your vehicle while you are parking. (Gen 2 Only) - When Pet Comfort is active, the center or rear display now provide instructions to temporarily enable the open door buttons if someone is locked inside the vehicle. (Gen 2 Only)

features.title: New Launch Mode for Tri-Motor Vehicles
features.description: Designed for use on a closed circuit track in dry road conditions, Launch mode provides maximum off-the-line acceleration and increased top speed, along with race stats for 0-to-60 mph (0-to-100 km/h) and quarter-mile race times. To activate Launch mode, go to Drive Modes and choose Sport mode. Then choose Launch mode and follow the on-screen instructions. For more information and important warnings, go to the Owner's Guide and search for Launch mode .

features.title: Navigation Improvements
features.description: We've made the following enhancements: - Increased the accuracy of traffic data and improved route color-coding. - Integrated trip preferences with the navigation settings for greater ease of use so you can access trip preferences at any time. - Made route previews available while you change trip preferences during a drive. Improved the navigation search experience: - Updated the search with Google Maps to show an auto-complete suggestion as you enter a word. Select the auto-complete suggestion to see the search results. - Added complete addresses of locations and the search terms you used to recent search results. - With Connect+, added place details, such as photos, from Google Maps to points of interest so you can be better informed about potential destinations.

features.title: Enhanced Auto Mode for Cabin Climate
features.description: When the climate system is in Auto mode, the fan speed control now has three options: Low, Medium, or High. Also, if you change the fan speed, the climate system remains in Auto mode to keep the cabin climate comfortable.

features.title: Color Themes for Accent Lighting
features.description: You can now customize the color theme of the accent lights. Go to Settings > Vehicle > Displays and Lighting. Choose the current theme, and more options appear. Select a theme to preview it and hear its corresponding audio, which you can mute. When the accent lights are turned on, you can adjust the brightness.

features.title: Additional Improvements
features.description: Apple Music - Fixed an issue that caused incorrect artwork to appear for a track. - Fixed an issue that displayed an unnecessary "internet connection" error message when you entered the vehicle. - Made improvements to the stability of the app. Infotainment - Fixed an issue that prevented the Library tab from initially loading media in Spotify. - Fixed a rare issue that caused Spotify to load a previous user's playlists. - Fixed a rare issue in which the icons on the driver display incorrectly switched between day and night modes. - Fixed a rare issue that caused an emergency phone call using the Phone app to fail. Other - In Audible, fixed a rare issue that caused audiobooks and podcasts to overlap on the Home screen. - Reduced the lower limit of the Pet Comfort temperature setting to 63°F (17°C). You can set these lower temperatures on the center display or in the Rivian mobile app version 2.13.0 or later. (Thanks to the "Out of Spec" pets for the feedback!) - While not in Park, your vehicle can now use your phone's Wi-Fi hotspot for internet connectivity. Also fixed an issue that occurred while tethering from a mobile hotspot. - Added support of special characters (non-ASClI or non-UTF-8) in the wireless network name or SSID for Wi-FI connectivity. (This excludes tab, newline, and carriage return characters.) - Added the entry lights status, on or off, to the vehicle in the Camping app. - Improved the reliability of the Gear Guard app. Also fixed an issue that kept videos from appearing or loading properly. - If enabled, Car Wash mode now remains enabled after the vehicle sleeps. - Fixed an issue that caused charging rates to differ slightly on the center and driver displays. - Improved rendering of your Rivian vehicle on the driver display. Also added translucence to tall objects when detected behind your Rivian vehicle. - Fixed an issue that caused the Towing icon to overlap the Drive Mode icon on the driver display. - Fixed a very rare issue that temporarily froze certain areas of the driver display. - For defrost or defog, increased airflow at the proper temperature to quickly clear the windshield while keeping the cabin climate comfortable during cold weather conditions. - Estimated charging costs now appear on the center and driver displays when you start charging using the Rivian mobile app or Plug & Charge. - Improved the accuracy of the estimated remaining charge time for an active Climate Schedule. - You can now save minor seat position adjustments to your driver profile. - Improved the smoothness of reengaging Highway Assist after a lane change. - Fixed a rare issue in which a navigation notification on the center display incorrectly showed the battery as critically low. - Fixed an intermittent issue in which the overhead lights didn't turn on if you opened a door while the vehicle was asleep. - Made stability improvements to the backup camera view. - Improved the 12 V battery replacement notification and recovery if the battery health is very low. - Reduced the noise level of the climate system when you change the recirulation setting. (Gen 2 Only) - Improved battery performance during aggressive driving in high ambient temperatures (Gen 2 Only) - Fixed a rare issue that inadvertently stoppped DC fast charging and caused unnecessary notifications on the center display. (Gen 2 Only) - Improved phone detection, power modulation, and foreign object detection on the wireless charger (Gen 2 Only) - If you try to lock your vehicle but it is already locked, the vehicle flashes its exterior lights to indicate locking is complete. (Gen 2 Only) - If you request to open the hood while the windshield wipers are in Service mode, the hood unlatches but won't automatically open; however you can manually open it. (Gen 2 Only) - Improved the appearance of surrounding vehicles, bicycles, and pedestrians on the driver display. (Gen 2 Only) - Fixed an issue that caused certain notifications to flicker on the driver display. (Gen 2 Only) - Fixed an issue that caused charging rates to differ slightly on the center and driver displays. (Gen 2 Only)

features.title: 60-Day Trial of Connect+
features.description: You're automatically enrolled in a 60-day Connect+ trial! This upgrade unlocks the potential of your connected vehicle, with premium media app streaming and an in-vehicle hotspot available now, and video app streaming and Gear Guard live streaming available in future updates. Go to Settings > Upgrades on the center display to manage your upgrades, or use the Rivian mobile app. Before your trial expires, you can subscribe to keep Connect+ features active.

features.title: Apple Music Now Available in the Media App
features.description: Apple Music® is now available in your vehicle! Go to the Media app, open the Apple Music app icon, and follow the prompts to sign in. NOTES - Dolby Atmos® is available for select content, and is enabled by default. To disable it, open the Apple Music app, choose your account icon in the upper right, and select Spatial Audio . You may experience changes in volume level when you switch between content formats. Enhancements to the Rivian audio experience will come in future updates. - An active Apple Music subscription is required to use the Apple Music app in your vehicle. To get up to 3 free months of Apple Music, use the Rivian mobile app version 2.12.1 or later.

features.title: Audible Now Available in the Media App
features.description: In the Media app, you can now use Audible to listen to audiobooks and newsworthy podcasts! Open the Audible icon and follow the prompts to get started. NOTES - Dolby Atmos is available for select content. Open the Audible app, choose your account icon in the upper right, and select Spatial Audio to manage the Dolby Atmos setting. - Audible Premium Plus gives you access to thousands of included audiobooks, podcasts, and Originals. Eligible customers get up to 2 months free of Audible Premium Plus. Offer details will be emailed to Rivian account owners.

features.title: Power Outlets Improvements
features.description: You can now choose to have power outlets turn on automatically when you enter the vehicle and turn off after you exit. Go to Energy > Outlets on the center display and select Auto .You can also: - Use the timer in conjunction with the Auto option to keep the outlets on after you exit the vehicle (to help power your campsite, for example). - Continue to use the timer by itself as you have in the past. (Thanks, LP, for the suggestion!)

features.title: Additional Improvements
features.description: - In Navigation, improved the display of charger discovery when zoomed out—the pins are now more spread out instead of clustered together around the search location. Infotainment - Disabled the incoming call panel when the phone's voice assistant connects via Bluetooth" to the vehicle speaker and microphone. - Added stars to the 3D cel-shaded night themes in Drive Modes and Camping. - Fixed an issue that caused the driver display to show rear visual alerts when the vehicle is in Drive with the rear accessory mode enabled. - Fixed an issue that caused 3D cel-shaded vehicle visualizations to show front bumper tow hooks on vehicles that don't have them. - Improved notifications of error states that prevent the switching of drive modes. Improved the third-row climate fan speed. Wi-Fi connectivity - If your vehicle is connected to a previously saved Wi-Fi network, it now maintains its connection even when you shift your vehicle out of Park. - Now when your vehicle is near a Rivian Service Center or office, it automatically connects to the Rivian secure Wi-Fi network named Rivian Vehicles. - Fixed an issue that turned off a previously active Wi-Fi hotspot after a vehicle restart. - Fixed an issue that caused the "Trailer Detected" notification to erroneously appear (due to water ingress) when the vehicle was in Drive. - Made an improvement to prevent time spoofing via the Network Time Protocol (NTP). - Fixed an issue that disabled Gear Guard videos and showed a "Media is Offline" message on the Gear Guard app on the center display.

features.description: The new High Beams Assist: Adaptive option activates high beams in low-light road conditions when the vehicle doesn't detect street lighting or light from the road. It also partially switches off high beams based on the vehicle traffic detected by the front camera. To enable or disable this feature, go to Settings > Vehicle > Displays and Lighting on the center display and select High Beams Assist: Adaptive .

features.description: We've improved the Rivian Autonomy Platform data update experience. To automatically receive updates, connect your vehicle to Wi-Fi. features.title: Refreshed Visual Interface with 3D Cel Shading
features.description: We refreshed the visual interface in the following ways: Redesigned our vehicle apps using 3D cel shading powered by Unreal Engine to provide a more dynamic user environment and interactive user experience. All in-vehicle displays and the Rivian mobile app now support this new design philosophy. Redesigned the driver display power bar, gear indicator, and Navigation to provide bolder visualizations to seamlessly work with live camera views. Updated the in-vehicle displays with an all-new, Rivian proprietary Adventure font!

features.title: Live Camera View Added to the Blind Spot Monitoring
features.description: Now when you activate a turn signal, the driver display shows a live camera view of the area to the side of the vehicle (in the direction of the turn). This helps you change lanes and turn the vehicle more safely. Blind Spot Monitoring is on by default. To turn it off, go to Settings > Driver+ .

features.title: Climate Control Improvements
features.description: Improved, ergonomically placed climate controls now include: - Vent presets for quick one-tap positioning of the face vents. - Direct access to side mirror heating. - Ability to switch between seat heating and seat cooling from the bottom of the center display. - Ability to turn steering wheel heating on or off from the domain bar.

features.title: New Suspension Software for Better Ride Comfort
features.description: We made these enhancements to the vehicle suspension software: - Fine-tuned damping for all drive modes to provide an improved driving experience. - Re-tuned Ride Feel options to offer a broader range of body control settings. - Improved software sensing and added automatic adjustment of damping control for varying load conditions, such as when carrying additional passengers, gear, or when towing a trailer. - Improved terrain management for a smoother experience on uneven or rough roads. - Improved pitch management during acceleration and braking, resulting in a smoother launch off the line and reduced nosedive when decelerating.

features.title: Options for Automatic Software Updates
features.description: The center display and Rivian mobile app 2.10.0 include options to automatically install updates. When the vehicle notifies you that an update is available, you can schedule it for later or you can schedule all future updates for a specific time. Go to Settings > Vehicle > Updates on the center display to manage the settings. NOTES - The vehicle notifies you before any update is installed. - The vehicle waits at least eight hours between the software download and installation to ensure you are aware the update is scheduled.

features.title: Improved Google Maps Search
features.description: We improved the quality of our Google power search results in the Navigation app.

features.title: Additional Improvements
features.description: - With the Rivian mobile app version 2.10.0 or later, you can now use a trailer profile that you created in the vehicle center display to plan a towing trip. NOTE The app also offers a generic, "default" trailer profile that you can use if you don't have any custom trailers defined. - We enhanced the look of the turn signal indicators so they are more visible and easier to notice. Infotainment - Fixed an issue that caused the media panel to close after audio was paused. - Fixed an issue that caused the live camera view to freeze momentarily when you switched between day and night modes with the Camera app on the center display and the vehicle in Reverse. Climate - Improved vent positions to more consistently save and restore them after the vehicle sleeps. - Improved performance of climate control in sunny conditions. - Fixed an issue that caused the rear window defrost setting to toggle rapidly. - Fixed a very rare issue that prevented the charge port door from opening. - Fixed an issue that made Vehicle Shipping mode text difficult to see in the title bar of the Vehicle > Service panel. - Improved proximity lock and unlock tuning for the iPhone® 15 Pro Max. - On Gen 1 Dual Motor standard pack vehicles, fixed an issue that prevented the High regen setting in Drive Modes > Brake Regen from appearing in the center display. - On a subset of Gen 1 R1T Quad Motor early VINs, fixed an issue that displayed an incorrect range.

features.title: Charging Score
features.description: Now when you select a charging station in Navigation or in the Rivian mobile app 2.8.0 (or later), you'll see a charging score based on key factors such as success rate and time it takes to start charging. Trip plans will automatically take these charging scores into account (where they're available) to help you avoid sites with lower scores. You can also adjust your charging map filters to hide sites with low scores.

features.title: Send Navigation, Mapping, and Charging Feedback
features.description: Also in Navigation, you now have an option to send feedback to us on any navigation, mapping, and charging issues. Go to the feedback icon to submit your comments.

features.title: Rear Display Improvements
features.description: We updated the rear display with a new layout, and added more functionality that includes access to: - Navigation trip progress - Power outlet controls - Media panel to view what's currently playing and the ability to play or pause - Rear vent and seat heat controls - Hotspot connection - Bluetooth connection - Interior lights control You can also now lock the rear display screen via a quick control in the center display.

features.title: Additional Improvements
features.description: Improved Pet Comfort temperature control by increasing the amount of airflow in the cabin. Improved ride height adjustments to reduce the number of occasions that require the vehicle to raise before a drive. Infotainment - Added new content to the Off-Road Driving section of the R1 Owner's Guide with guidelines and tips to help you drive more safely and confidently off road. - Fixed an issue that caused the center display to show the outlets timer numbers in the incorrect day or night theme. - Fixed a rare issue that caused the driver display to show an extra non-functional garage door option. - Fixed an intermittent issue that prevented playlists from displaying while media streamed over a Bluetooth connection. - Fixed a very rare issue that caused the Phone panel to crash and display a blank screen when the Bluetooth phone switcher or preset settings were repeatedly tapped. Other - In Navigation, improved the swipe down behavior of the turn-by-turn instruction panel to make it easier to open while driving. - Fixed a rare issue that prevented Gear Guard from starting up and capturing video when the Motion Cam was turned on through the Rivian mobile app. - Fixed a rare issue that disabled Hotspot. - Fixed a rare issue that caused software package downloads to fail when the vehicle was connected to Wi-Fi. - Fixed an issue that caused a charge session to stop earlier than expected when state of charge (SoC) limit was set to 50%. - Fixed a rare issue during vehicle unlocking that prevented one or more of the door handles from presenting and mirrors from unfolding. - Fixed a very rare issue during vehicle wake that caused an incorrect alert to appear that said the Gear Tunnel door was open when it wasn't. - Fixed a rare issue that caused the vehicle to lock unexpectedly when the key fob or phone key was inside. - Improved the lock behavior to prevent lock out when the driver door is open, you lock the vehicle from the center display, exit the vehicle, and close the door. The driver door now unlocks and an error sound plays.

features.title: Cold Weather Improvements
features.description: We have made several improvements to give you better visibility into how cold weather can affect your vehicle energy, or range, and what you can do to manage it. The vehicle and the Rivian mobile app now let you know when, and by how much, your range is affected by cold weather. The driver display, Energy app, and Rivian mobile app include a battery graphic that uses blue shading to indicate how much range is temporarily unavailable. The vehicle and the Rivian mobile app provide preemptive notifications when your vehicle is most susceptible to range loss and when your range has reduced due to the battery becoming cold. When your range is impacted or may become impacted, you can open the Winter Driving Tips guide in the Rivian mobile app. This new guide provides insight on improving your experience in cold weather. It includes information on how to recover range due to cold and other useful tips, like scheduling your drive, using Snow mode, and conditioning the cabin before driving. You can also access the Winter Driving Tips guide in the support articles at rivian.com/support/vehicle-docs. We improved charging logic to better prepare the battery pack for your next drive and help recover range more predictably. NOTE Cold-weather and range loss notifications require version 3.9 or later of the Rivian mobile app.

features.title: Apple Watch App (Gen 1)
features.description: The latest Rivian mobile app update includes a companion app for your Apple Watch. This allows you to remotely access and control your vehicle from your Apple Watch. Access to your vehicle is easy: you can lock or unlock your vehicle with a tap of the Lock icon. With the app open, you can start to drive. NOTE You must foreground the Apple Watch app to ensure that your Apple Watch can be used as a key for your Rivian vehicle. You can also use the Apple Watch app to lock or unlock your doors, vent your windows, or sound the alarm, all with a simple tap on your wrist. For even more control, use the digital crown to set a target state of charge or adjust the cabin temperature. Additionally, the app’s customizable design lets you choose up to four quick controls for instant access to the features you use most. Go to the Owner's Guide on the center display for more information about all the Apple Watch app has to offer. NOTE The Apple Watch app requires version 3.9 or later of the Rivian mobile app. More About Watch App

features.title: Apple Watch App (Gen 2)

Then you can start to drive. You can also use the Apple Watch app to lock or unlock your doors, vent your windows, or sound the alarm, all with a simple tap on your wrist. Additionally, the app’s customizable design lets you choose up to four quick controls for instant access to the features you use most. Go to the Owner's Guide on the center display for more information about all the Apple Watch app has to offer. NOTE The Apple Watch app requires version 3.9 or later of the Rivian mobile app. More About Watch App

features.title: Exciting New Updates for Drive Modes
features.description: We further enhanced the driving experience: Performance Dual-Motor and Quad-Motor (Gen 2) now offers Launch mode, which is designed for use on a closed circuit track in dry road conditions and provides racing stats for 0-60 mph (0-100 km/h) and quarter-mile race times, along with visualizations and driver coaching. Go to Drive Modes and choose Sport mode on the center display. Then choose Launch mode and follow the on-screen instructions. For more information and important warnings, go to the Owner's Guide and search for Launch mode. Sport mode is now available on all Dual-Motor variants. Sport mode prioritizes on-road vehicle performance and optimizes responsiveness and handling in all-wheel drive. Sport mode now offers Standard ride height. Sport mode now offers Firm and Moderate ride feel settings to more accurately reflect the vehicle’s performance. For Quad- and Tri-Motor, we have increased the top speed in Rock Crawl mode to 33 mph (53 km/h) to enable more usability between obstacles on trail. You can now change between all on-road drive modes and adjust ride height, ride feel, and brake regen settings while Adaptive Cruise Control and Highway Assist (Gen 1) or Universal Hands Free (Gen 2) are engaged.

features.title: Enhanced Kneel Mode
features.description: Getting in and out of your vehicle just got a whole lot smoother. We’ve redesigned Kneel Mode to be more responsive, more accessible, and available exactly when you need it. Kneel Mode now handles more challenging parking spots with ease, on steeper slopes up to 15% grade and uneven surfaces up to 25% side-tilt. Your vehicle will now lower even further in Kneel Mode, making it easier than ever to enter, exit, or load gear. We’ve re-engineered our algorithms so your vehicle can now kneel from High ride height and across all on-road drive modes, including All-Purpose, Sport, Conserve, and Snow. You can now trigger Kneel Mode on demand via a new Quick Control option to activate the lowering process while traveling at low speeds, less than 20 mph (32 km/h). If Kneel Mode isn’t available due to specific conditions, we’ll let you know why. If the Kneel icon is greyed out in your Quick Controls, simply choose it to learn more about why Kneel is unavailable. Thanks, Cambry, for the feedback!

features.title: Unreal Engine 5 Upgrade

Improvements include better anti-aliasing, smoother animations, and increased capability to render a larger number of surrounding vehicles, bicycles, and pedestrians on the driver display.

features.title: Introducing Autonomy+

Existing owners are automatically enrolled in a 60-day trial of Autonomy+. At the end of the trial, you’ll have the option to add Autonomy+ to your vehicle as a monthly subscription or one-time purchase. Learn more about Autonomy+ at rivian.com/autonomy and sign up from your Rivian account page or the Rivian mobile app ( version 3.9 or higher). NOTE R1T and R1S Quad-Motor Launch Edition vehicles include a lifetime subscription to Autonomy+.

features.title: Universal Hands-Free
features.description: Universal Hands-Free steers, accelerates, and brakes your vehicle on roads with marked lanes, allowing you to let go of the steering wheel for extended periods, as long as you’re looking at the road. Universal Hands-Free is now available on more than 3.5 million miles (5.6 million km) of roads in the US and Canada, and it relies on Driver Attention Detection to confirm that you’re paying attention to the road ahead of you. When Universal Hands-Free is available on a marked road as indicated by the Universal Hands-Free icon near the speedometer, pull the drive stalk towards you twice to activate Universal Hands-Free. System Limitations Universal Hands-Free is an advanced driver assistance feature designed to support the driver, but doesn't replace the driver's attention, judgment, and need to control the vehicle. Universal Hands-Free doesn't make your vehicle autonomous or self-driving. Stay alert at all times of road conditions. Always be prepared to take control of the vehicle if needed. Universal Hands-Free isn’t a point-to-point system and doesn’t make turns or follow navigation instructions. If you’re in a turn-only lane, you must take control of the vehicle and steer it appropriately. Universal Hands-Free doesn’t automatically stop at traffic lights and stop signs. Notifications may appear, and you must take the appropriate action in these scenarios. It is your responsibility to follow traffic laws. Universal Hands-Free doesn’t update the set speed automatically as the speed limits change. It is your responsibility to monitor the posted speed limits and adjust the set speed. Don't use Universal Hands-Free in unsupported conditions such as when a trailer is connected, the vehicle tows heavy loads, or clearly marked lanes aren't present. Don't use Universal Hands-Free on slippery, unpaved, wet, or snowy roads. Universal Hands-Free won't do the following: Drive the vehicle through high curvature roads such as roundabouts and sharp turns. Detect special-use lanes such as bike lanes, bus lanes, and emergency lanes. Detect and react to oncoming or crossing vehicles, uncommon objects, or odd-shaped objects including, but not limited to, open doors, barrels, poles, debris, and trailers. React promptly to road users around blind corners, crossing intersections, and narrow driving situations. Slow down or stop for speed bumps, dips, upcoming traffic lights, or stop signs. Steer in response to temporary lane lines marked by cones, barrels, or similar construction materials. React to special crossing scenarios such as railway crossings. Follow navigation prompts or make turns in turn lanes. For more information and important warnings, go to the Owner's Guide on the center display and search for Universal Hands-Free .

features.title: Autonomy Drive Styles
features.description: Autonomy Drive Styles allow you to customize the driving behavior of our driver assistance systems and features: Universal Hands-Free, Highway Assist, Adaptive Cruise Control, and Lane Change on Command. Choose Mild for a relaxed style with more gap distance and more gradual lane changes. Choose Medium for a balanced style to manage cut-ins and accelerate with traffic flow. Choose Spicy for a more dynamic style with a tighter gap distance and quicker steering during lane changes. To change Drive Styles while you drive, press the thumb control buttons on the right side of the steering wheel.

features.title: Rivian Digital Key
features.description: Use the new digital key through the native Wallet app on your iPhone® and Apple Watch®, Google Pixel, or Samsung device to seamlessly access and drive your vehicle. Digital key offers these benefits: Greater reliability for passive entry. Enhanced accuracy and security with the use of UWB (Ultra Wide Band) technology. Improved interoperability across devices. Ability to easily share up to 8 keys with family and friends. Vehicle access via NFC (Near Field Communications) for up to 5 hours after your phone runs out of battery power. Digital key is available with the vehicle software version 2025.46 or later and the Rivian mobile app version 3.8.0 or later. Use only the Rivian mobile app for setup. The mobile app notifies you about the digital key option, or go to Settings > Drivers and keys > Upgrade your phone key in the mobile app. Follow the on-screen instructions to complete the setup. For more information, go to the Owner's Guide on the center display and search for digital key .

features.title: RAD Tuner Drive Mode: Create, Customize, Curate
features.description: The Rivian Adventure Department (RAD) brings you RAD Tuner, which was developed by the team behind our historic wins at Rebelle Rally and Pikes Peak International Hill Climb. Exclusive to Quad-Motor vehicles, this feature allows you to go beyond the factory presets and optimize the vehicle's dynamic behavior for your preferences and the terrain. Use intuitive touch sliders to build and save custom drive modes by adjusting these independent settings: Acceleration Regen Brake assist Steering assist Ride height Torque balance Wheel slip Stability Damping Roll stiffness DANGER Keep Stability on in most driving conditions. Electronic Stability Control optimizes vehicle traction and provides anti-skid support. Turning off Stability disables Electronic Stability Control. To access RAD Tuner mode, go to Drive Modes on the center display. Choose RAD Tuner presets next to the Off-Road tab. For more information and important warnings, go to the Owner's Guide on the center display and search for RAD Tuner .

features.title: Introducing Kick Turn
features.description: For Quad-Motor vehicles only, boost its off-road agility with Kick Turn. By leveraging the power of all four motors working together, your vehicle can now rotate in place or significantly reduce its turning radius while moving at speeds under 15 mph (24 km/h). Whether you are navigating a tight hairpin, tackling a switchback, or turning around on a blocked trail, you can now pivot precisely where you need to go. No more 3-point turns—go off-road and kick it responsibly. DANGER Only use Kick Turn on flat, smooth, hard-packed dirt roads or trails. Never use Kick Turn on deep surfaces such as sand or mud. To activate Kick Turn, go to Drive Modes on the center display, and choose All-Terrain or Rock Crawl . Then choose Kick Turn mode and follow the on-screen instructions. For more information and important warnings, go to the Owner's Guide on the center display and search for Kick Turn .

features.title: Happy Haunting!
features.description: If you dare, gather your family and friends for some Halloween frights and fun! Touch the eerie scene in the All-Purpose drive mode screen on the center display. Can you find what’s lurking? Dress your car up in its costume to enter a world of spooky images, foreboding sounds, and ghastly lights! Is that a frog I hear? Yikes! A swamp monster! To don the costume: Update the Rivian mobile app on your phone to version 3.6.0. Place the vehicle in P (Park), and make sure it has more than 30 miles of range. Turn off Pet Comfort and Vehicle Shipping mode (if they’re on). Make sure to have WiFi or cellular reception on the vehicle and on your phone. Tap Let's Get Spooky on the main screen of the Rivian mobile app to dive in! NOTES While car costume is on, passive entry and the horn are disabled, and range decreases slightly. Car costume stays on after you leave the vehicle, so turn it off through the mobile app (or press the brake pedal) if you want to preserve the vehicle battery.

features.title: Climate Improvements
features.description: Climate Hold is a new setting that runs the climate system for a set amount of time after you exit the vehicle, maintaining cabin temperatures while you’re away, and keeping any remaining occupants comfortable. Use the Rivian mobile app to monitor climate status, the Hold time remaining, and to turn Hold on or off NOTE When leaving pets alone in the vehicle, use Pet Comfort instead of Hold as it has specific behaviors meant to keep your pets as safe and comfortable as possible. Auto cabin ventilation is a new setting that automatically blows ambient air into the parked vehicle on warm days to help prevent extremely high temperatures in the cabin. This feature is on by default, and notifies you in the Rivian mobile app when it’s running. You can turn it on or off in the mobile app. Auto air recirculation now appears as an option when you cycle through the Air Recirculation settings in the center display. When in Auto air recirculation mode, the system automatically switches between pulling in outside air and recirculating cabin air to optimize comfort, cabin air quality, and energy efficiency.

features.title: Climate Improvements

features.description: The new Co-Steer feature allows you to adjust your position within a lane using gentle steering inputs while Highway Assist is active without the system disengaging. To use this feature, go to Video > Launch in the center display, and turn on Record video during launch events.

features.title: Driver Assistance Improvements
features.description: You can now use Driver Assistance features when an electrical accessory is connected to the tow hitch of your vehicle. To enable this, go to Drive Modes > Trailers and select Accessory. NOTES An accessory is defined as a vehicle attachment that doesn't have an axle and isn’t directly supported by the ground. It's your responsibility to select the correct profile when towing a trailer. Driver assistance features may not work as designed if a large electrical accessory is attached in the rear of the vehicle. Go Chime now provides a chime only when Driver Attention Detection confirms the driver is not looking at the road when a vehicle ahead drives away. Go Chime no longer chimes when the Driver Attention Detection feature confirms the driver is looking at the road ahead. (Gen 2 only) When the vehicle comes to a stop while Adaptive Cruise Control or Highway Assist is engaged, and Driver Attention Detection confirms the driver is looking at the road ahead, the vehicle now extends the active period of the driver assistance feature before pausing. (Gen 2 only)

features.title: Introducing New Vehicle Dynamics Handling Control Logic
features.description: We developed a new control software to allow a greater separation between Ride and Handling maneuvers across all Drive modes, resulting in improved ride comfort on straightaways and improved roll control during cornering. Benefits to Drive modes include: All-Purpose - Reduced ride trade-offs between casual driving and spirited driving Sport - Increased roll damping during sustained cornering Rally - Enhanced composure over rough terrain to deliver a more engaging and comfortable driving experience Rock Crawl - Improved body control during low-speed, cross-axle articulation scenarios

features.title: Multi-factor Drive
features.description: You can now enable Multi-factor Drive to require a second form of authentication before starting your vehicle. This industry-leading feature increases the security of your vehicle by requiring you to authenticate each time you drive it. When Multi-factor Drive is enabled and you press the brake to shift out of P (Park), a notification appears on the center display. Then you can authenticate from the Rivian mobile app, version 3.1 or later, or via the actionable notification on your smartwatch. If you do not receive the notification, you can also enter a time-based passcode that displays on your smartphone. To enable Multi-factor Drive, log in to the primary owner account in the Rivian mobile app, go to Security and Access, and turn on Multi-factor Drive. NOTE -Only a vehicle owner can enable or disable Multi-factor Drive. The setting applies to all drivers and keys associated with the vehicle. -When Multi-factor Drive is enabled, a driver won’t be able to drive the vehicle using the key fob or key card without authentication. -To approve a driver, the driver must have a Rivian account associated with the key and the key must be paired with the vehicle. -As a backup option, the driver can also access a time-based passcode on their smartphone. Go to Security and Access and choose View time-based passcode. -To use Multi-factor Drive, all drivers must have a Rivian mobile app version 3.1 or later installed on their smartphone.

features.title: New Rivian Energy App
features.description: The new Rivian Energy app introduced features and improvements to increase your understanding and control over your vehicle’s energy consumption while driving, parked, or charging. In addition, you can now precondition your battery on demand for fast charging and view your charge curve in the vehicle with improved charge time accuracy. This can help with trip planning and provide greater peace of mind by making your energy usage easier to understand and visualize.

features.title: Energy Monitor Tab
features.description: - Projected range impact: Increase your understanding of your actual energy consumption versus what’s expected while driving and while in P (Park). You can gain insight into how your driving behavior affects your range and get useful driving tips. You can also view your parked energy usage on the Rivian mobile app. - Usage: Dive deep into your energy usage over selectable timeframes. - Session details: View a comprehensive distribution of systems in your vehicle that are consuming energy, including Gear Guard, outlets, and climate.

features.title: Charging Tab
features.description: - Graph: Visualize your active or latest charging session with an interactive graph. - Target level for charging stops: When using navigation for a trip that includes a charging stop, now it’s easy to see the recommended charge target for your trip from the vehicle or the Rivian mobile app. Simply start your charge, and the app will calculate and notify you (both in the vehicle and on the Rivian mobile app) when you’ve reached the ideal charge level for your trip. - On-demand battery preconditioning: Precondition your battery on demand for fast charging. The system heats or cools the battery to the optimal temperature for fast charging. View the new Energy app on your center display and on the Rivian mobile app, version 3.1 or later.

features.title: Charging Improvements
features.description: We’ve improved DC fast charging performance and consistency for Max pack batteries. Max pack batteries now have improved charge times and expanded capability across a larger range of temperatures. - Optimized charging algorithms to reduce the time required when charging the battery from 10% to 80%.

features.title: Charging Improvements
features.description: We’ve improved DC fast charging performance and consistency for all battery pack variants. All battery pack variants now have improved charge times and expanded capability across a larger range of temperatures. Max Pack and Standard Pack: Optimized charging algorithms to reduce the time required when charging the battery from 10% to 80%. Large Pack: Optimized charging algorithms to: Improve peak charge rate. Reduce the time required when charging the battery from 10% to 80% Increase the number of miles added in the first 15 minutes of charging.

features.title: Multi-factor Drive
features.description: You can now enable Multi-factor Drive to require a second form of authentication before starting your vehicle. This industry-leading feature increases the security of your vehicle by requiring you to authenticate each time you drive it. When Multi-factor Drive is enabled and you press the brake to shift out of P (Park), a notification appears on the center display. Then you can authenticate from the Rivian mobile app, version 3.1 or later, or via the actionable notification on your smartwatch. If you do not receive the notification, you can also enter a time-based passcode that displays on your smartphone. To enable Multi-factor Drive, log in to the primary owner account in the Rivian mobile app, go to Security and Access, and turn on Multi-factor Drive. NOTE -Only a vehicle owner can enable or disable Multi-factor Drive. The setting applies to all drivers and keys associated with the vehicle. -When Multi-factor Drive is enabled, a driver won’t be able to drive the vehicle using the key fob or key card without authentication. -To approve a driver, the driver must have a Rivian account associated with the key and the key must be paired with the vehicle. -As a backup option, the driver can also access a time-based passcode on their smartphone. Go to Security and Access and choose View time-based passcode. -To use Multi-factor Drive, all drivers must have a Rivian mobile app version 3.1 or later installed on their smartphone.

This can help with trip planning and provide greater peace of mind by making your energy usage easier to understand and visualize.

features.description: If you swap wheels and tires on your vehicle, you can now update your vehicle’s configuration to match, so that your vehicle provides accurate range and efficiency estimates, as well as optimal driving performance and handling. To view the current wheel and tire configuration on the Rivian mobile app version 2.20.0 or later, open the Vehicle tab and choose Vehicle Health. For information about how to change a tire, open the Owner's Guide and search for Tire Change.

features.title: New Drive Mode for Performance Dual-Motor Vehicles
features.description: With this software update, we’ve made Performance Dual-Motor vehicles more capable. Go to Drive Modes > Off-Road on the center display to access Rally mode.

features.title: Performance Upgrade Available For Purchase
features.description: For Dual-Motor vehicles that weren’t originally purchased with the Performance Upgrade, you can unlock faster acceleration and more torque from your vehicle's drive system with the new Performance Upgrade. This upgrade, now available for eligible vehicles, also enhances your driving experience with three additional drive modes: - Sport mode prioritizes on-road vehicle performance and a responsive driving experience. - Soft Sand mode maximizes vehicle performance and capability in deep sand. - Rally mode delivers heightened throttle response and crisper steering response on almost any surface, including ice, mud, dirt, or asphalt. To make your one-time purchase of this upgrade, sign in to your Rivian account or use the Rivian mobile app version 2.20.0 or later. Navigate to Profile > Manage account > Upgrades. NOTE Visit rivian.com/support to learn about vehicle eligibility. Details

features.title: Auto-Tilting of Side Mirrors in Reverse
features.description: The side mirrors can automatically tilt down when you shift the vehicle into R (Reverse) to help you parallel park or back your vehicle into a space. You can also customize the tilt positions and save them to your profile while the vehicle is parked. This feature is disabled by default. To enable it, go to Settings > Vehicle > Access and turn on Side mirror auto-tilting.

Open the Vehicle tab, and choose Location. Connectivity improvements - Improved the performance of Wi-Fi® roaming when the vehicle switches from one Wi-Fi network or access point to another. - Fixed an issue that caused the vehicle to connect to its own Wi-Fi hotspot. - Fixed a rare issue that displayed an incorrect maximum number of hotspot connections on the center display. Camera views improvements - Fixed an issue that prevented the front camera view from displaying when the vehicle travels at low speeds and is close to an object in front of it. - Fixed a rare issue that caused the surround view cameras to be unavailable when the vehicle wakes from sleep. Additional Improvements - Improved vehicle battery efficiency while the vehicle is parked. - Improved responsiveness of proximity unlocking with a phone key while the vehicle is parked. - Improved the consistency of Roomy entry and exit behavior after the vehicle wakes from sleep. - Fixed an issue that prevented certain accounts from playing music in Apple Music. - Fixed a rare issue of increased volume levels for media sources after the vehicle wakes from sleep. - Improved stability of the infotainment system.

features.title: New Lock Sound for the Day or Night
features.description: You now have the option to set the exterior lock sound to a bluebird chirp or an owl hoot. You can also set it to Day/Night, which alternates the lock sound between a bluebird chirp during daytime conditions and an owl hoot during nighttime conditions. Go to Settings > Vehicle > Access on the center display. (Thank you, r/Rivian community, for the feedback.)

features.title: New Key Fob for Gen 2 Vehicles
features.description: The Gear Shop now offers a new key fob as a separate physical key for your vehicle. To start the pairing process on your smartphone, open the Rivian mobile app version 2.16 or later. Go to Drivers and keys and add the new key fob, or scan the QR code on the box containing your key fob. NOTES - Use the Rivian mobile app only. (Setup isn’t available through the center display of the vehicle.) - Only the vehicle owner can add a new key fob.

features.title: Driver Profile Enhancements
features.description: Your driver profile now links to your media streaming accounts, so when the vehicle recognizes your driver profile at the start of a drive, the vehicle automatically loads your media streaming accounts. Supported apps include Apple Music, Audible, Spotify®, TIDAL®, and TuneIn. Your driver profile also saves your media, climate, driver assistance, and units of measurement settings. Climate settings include vent positions, vent presets, and Auto mode status.

features.title: Place AI Summaries from Google Maps in Navigation
features.description: With Connect+ on your Rivian vehicles, navigation now displays Google Gemini AI summaries for many places, from restaurants to national parks.

features.title: Cabin Climate Improvements
features.description: To enhance your cabin climate comfort, we've made the following updates: - If the air conditioning is turned off, the temperature controls become fan speed controls at the bottom of the center display for quick access. We also improved the consistency of the fan speed control. - To more accurately convey the temperature of the conditioned air, the airflow depicted on the center display now shows different shades of blue for cooling or red for heating. - We improved cabin heating during extremely cold weather conditions. (2nd Gen Only)

features.title: Enhanced Lane Change on Command
features.description: For your convenience, Lane Change on Command can now slow the vehicle to find a gap in the target lane before initiating a lane change.

features.title: Additional Improvements
features.description: Audio quality improvements: - Adjusted the tuning curve to improve clarity and remove muddiness. (2nd Gen Only) - Rebalanced the soundstage to be centered. (2nd Gen Only) - Fixed an issue that caused crackling noises during a phone call. (2nd Gen Only) Charging of Large battery packs: - Improved the accuracy of charge time estimates. (2nd Gen Only) - Optimized the charge time for DC fast charging. (2nd Gen Only) Vehicle access improvements: - Enhanced detection of the driver key to load the correct driver profile when the vehicle detects multiple keys. (2nd Gen Only) - Fixed an issue that prevented a key from opening the charge port door, front trunk, or tailgate when proximity locking is turned off at home. (2nd Gen Only) Gear Guard app improvements: - Updated the notification behavior to more clearly inform you if the onboard hard drive becomes full or close to full. - Improved Live Cam streaming to reset the one-hour daily limit at midnight if you stream for an hour a day. Also fixed a rare issue that caused the streaming to fail. Other - Fixed an issue that caused Apple Music to fail to play audio. - If the vehicle is equipped with an auxiliary air compressor, improved the behavior so the vehicle remains awake while inflating a tire or other item. - Fixed an issue that prevented the garage door opener prompt from appearing on the driver display even though the vehicle was at the location associated with that garage. - Improved notifications if offline sensors affect the phone key setup. (1st Gen Only) - Improved the response time so you can open the front trunk, Gear Tunnel door, tailgate, or tonneau cover (if equipped) with a single exterior button press as the vehicle wakes from sleep. features.title: New Launch Mode for Tri-Motor Vehicles
features.description: Designed for use on a closed circuit track in dry road conditions, Launch mode provides maximum off-the-line acceleration and increased top speed, along with race stats for 0-to-60 mph (0-to-100 km/h) and quarter-mile race times. To activate Launch mode, go to Drive Modes and choose Sport mode. Then choose Launch mode and follow the on-screen instructions. For more information and important warnings, go to the Owner's Guide and search for Launch mode .

features.title: Navigation Improvements
features.description: We've made the following enhancements: - Increased the accuracy of traffic data and improved route color-coding. - Integrated trip preferences with the navigation settings for greater ease of use so you can access trip preferences at any time. - Made route previews available while you change trip preferences during a drive. Improved the navigation search experience: - Updated the search with Google Maps to show an auto-complete suggestion as you enter a word. Select the auto-complete suggestion to see the search results. - Added complete addresses of locations and the search terms you used to recent search results. - With Connect+, added place details, such as photos, from Google Maps to points of interest so you can be better informed about potential destinations.

features.title: Enhanced Auto Mode for Cabin Climate
features.description: When the climate system is in Auto mode, the fan speed control now has three options: Low, Medium, or High. Also, if you change the fan speed, the climate system remains in Auto mode to keep the cabin climate comfortable.

features.title: Color Themes for Accent Lighting
features.description: You can now customize the color theme of the accent lights. Go to Settings > Vehicle > Displays and Lighting. Choose the current theme, and more options appear. Select a theme to preview it and hear its corresponding audio, which you can mute. When the accent lights are turned on, you can adjust the brightness.

features.title: Additional Improvements
features.description: Apple Music - Fixed an issue that caused incorrect artwork to appear for a track. - Fixed an issue that displayed an unnecessary "internet connection" error message when you entered the vehicle. - Made improvements to the stability of the app. Infotainment - Fixed an issue that prevented the Library tab from initially loading media in Spotify. - Fixed a rare issue that caused Spotify to load a previous user's playlists. - Fixed a rare issue in which the icons on the driver display incorrectly switched between day and night modes. - Fixed a rare issue that caused an emergency phone call using the Phone app to fail. Vehicle Commands To prevent inadvertent changes, the vehicle won't react to certain commands from the key fob or Rivian mobile app: - The windows won't go up or down while the vehicle is in Drive, Reverse, or Car Wash mode. - The vehicle won't lock or unlock while it is in Drive or Reverse. Other - In Audible, fixed a rare issue that caused audiobooks and podcasts to overlap on the Home screen. - Reduced the lower limit of the Pet Comfort temperature setting to 63°F (17°C). You can set these lower temperatures on the center display or in the Rivian mobile app version 2.13.0 or later. (Thanks to the "Out of Spec" pets for the feedback!) - While not in Park, your vehicle can now use your phone's Wi-Fi hotspot for internet connectivity. Also fixed an issue that occurred while tethering from a mobile hotspot. - Added support of special characters (non-ASClI or non-UTF-8) in the wireless network name or SSID for Wi-FI connectivity. (This excludes tab, newline, and carriage return characters.) - Added the entry lights status, on or off, to the vehicle in the Camping app. - Improved the reliability of the Gear Guard app. Also fixed an issue that kept videos from appearing or loading properly. - If enabled, Car Wash mode now remains enabled after the vehicle sleeps. - Fixed an issue that caused charging rates to differ slightly on the center and driver displays. - Improved rendering of your Rivian vehicle on the driver display. (Gen 2 Only) - Improved battery performance during aggressive driving in high ambient temperatures (Gen 2 Only) - Fixed a rare issue that inadvertently stoppped DC fast charging and caused unnecessary notifications on the center display. (Gen 2 Only) - Improved phone detection, power modulation, and foreign object detection on the wireless charger (Gen 2 Only) - If you try to lock your vehicle but it is already locked, the vehicle flashes its exterior lights to indicate locking is complete. (Gen 2 Only) - If you request to open the hood while the windshield wipers are in Service mode, the hood unlatches but won't automatically open; however you can manually open it. (Gen 2 Only) - Improved the appearance of surrounding vehicles, bicycles, and pedestrians on the driver display.
