features.title: 60-Day Trial of Connect+
features.description: You're automatically enrolled in a 60-day Connect+ trial! This upgrade unlocks the potential of your connected vehicle, with premium media app streaming and an in-vehicle hotspot available now, and video app streaming and Gear Guard live streaming available in future updates. Go to Settings > Upgrades on the center display to manage your upgrades, or use the Rivian mobile app. Before your trial expires, you can subscribe to keep Connect+ features active.

features.title: Apple Music Now Available in the Media App
features.description: Apple Music® is now available in your vehicle! Go to the Media app, open the Apple Music app icon, and follow the prompts to sign in. NOTES - Dolby Atmos® is available for select content, and is enabled by default. To disable it, open the Apple Music app, choose your account icon in the upper right, and select Spatial Audio . You may experience changes in volume level when you switch between content formats. Enhancements to the Rivian audio experience will come in future updates. - An active Apple Music subscription is required to use the Apple Music app in your vehicle. To get up to 3 free months of Apple Music, use the Rivian mobile app version 2.12.1 or later.

features.title: Audible Now Available in the Media App
features.description: In the Media app, you can now use Audible to listen to audiobooks and newsworthy podcasts! Open the Audible icon and follow the prompts to get started. NOTES - Dolby Atmos is available for select content. Open the Audible app, choose your account icon in the upper right, and select Spatial Audio to manage the Dolby Atmos setting. - Audible Premium Plus gives you access to thousands of included audiobooks, podcasts, and Originals. Eligible customers get up to 2 months free of Audible Premium Plus. Offer details will be emailed to Rivian account owners.

features.title: Power Outlets Improvements
features.description: You can now choose to have power outlets turn on automatically when you enter the vehicle and turn off after you exit. Go to Energy > Outlets on the center display and select Auto .You can also: - Use the timer in conjunction with the Auto option to keep the outlets on after you exit the vehicle (to help power your campsite, for example). - Continue to use the timer by itself as you have in the past. (Thanks, LP, for the suggestion!)

features.title: Additional Improvements
features.description: - In Navigation, improved the display of charger discovery when zoomed out—the pins are now more spread out instead of clustered together around the search location. Infotainment - Disabled the incoming call panel when the phone's voice assistant connects via Bluetooth" to the vehicle speaker and microphone. - Added stars to the 3D cel-shaded night themes in Drive Modes and Camping. - Fixed an issue that caused the driver display to show rear visual alerts when the vehicle is in Drive with the rear accessory mode enabled. - Fixed an issue that caused 3D cel-shaded vehicle visualizations to show front bumper tow hooks on vehicles that don't have them. - Improved notifications of error states that prevent the switching of drive modes. Improved the third-row climate fan speed. Wi-Fi connectivity - If your vehicle is connected to a previously saved Wi-Fi network, it now maintains its connection even when you shift your vehicle out of Park. - Now when your vehicle is near a Rivian Service Center or office, it automatically connects to the Rivian secure Wi-Fi network named Rivian Vehicles. Fixed an issue that turned off a previously active Wi-Fi hotspot after a vehicle restart. - Fixed an issue that caused the "Trailer Detected" notification to erroneously appear (due to water ingress) when the vehicle was in Drive. - Made an improvement to prevent time spoofing via the Network Time Protocol (NTP). - Fixed an issue that disabled Gear Guard videos and showed a "Media is Offline" message on the Gear Guard app on the center display.

features.description: The premium driver assistance features are now called the Rivian Autonomy Platform. The Rivian Autonomy Platform+ adds the new advanced feature, Lane Change on Command, which automatically performs lane changes in the direction of the turn signal while Highway Assist is engaged. NOTE Lane Change on Command is an assist feature. It doesn't replace your judgment as the driver or the need to monitor the vehicle's surroundings; be prepared to take over at any time.

NOTE Press to unlock follows the Door unlocking behavior option: control the driver-side door only or all doors. Go to Settings > Vehicle > Access at the bottom of the center display.

features.description: If you stop and park your vehicle on the side of the road, you can have your roadside lighting animate to direct traffic around your parked vehicle. To turn on roadside lighting, put your vehicle in Park, and open the quick controls panel. Go to Vehicle > Shortcuts > Roadside lighting from the status bar of the center display.

features.title: Refreshed Visual Interface with 3D Cel Shading
features.description: We refreshed the visual interface in the following ways: Redesigned our vehicle apps using 3D cel shading powered by Unreal Engine to provide a more dynamic user environment and interactive user experience. All in-vehicle displays and the Rivian mobile app now support this new design philosophy. Redesigned the driver display power bar, gear indicator, and Navigation to provide bolder visualizations to seamlessly work with live camera views. Updated the in-vehicle displays with an all-new, Rivian proprietary Adventure font!

features.title: Live Camera View Added to the Blind Spot Monitoring
features.description: Now when you activate a turn signal, the driver display shows a live camera view of the area to the side of the vehicle (in the direction of the turn). This helps you change lanes and turn the vehicle more safely. Blind Spot Monitoring is on by default. To turn it off, go to Settings > Driver+ .

features.title: Climate Control Improvements
features.description: Improved, ergonomically placed climate controls now include: - Vent presets for quick one-tap positioning of the face vents. - Direct access to side mirror heating. - Ability to switch between seat heating and seat cooling from the bottom of the center display. - Ability to turn steering wheel heating on or off from the domain bar.

features.title: New Suspension Software for Better Ride Comfort
features.description: We made these enhancements to the vehicle suspension software: - Fine-tuned damping for all drive modes to provide an improved driving experience. - Re-tuned Ride Feel options to offer a broader range of body control settings. - Improved software sensing and added automatic adjustment of damping control for varying load conditions, such as when carrying additional passengers, gear, or when towing a trailer. - Improved terrain management for a smoother experience on uneven or rough roads. - Improved pitch management during acceleration and braking, resulting in a smoother launch off the line and reduced nosedive when decelerating.

features.title: Options for Automatic Software Updates
features.description: The center display and Rivian mobile app 2.10.0 include options to automatically install updates. When the vehicle notifies you that an update is available, you can schedule it for later or you can schedule all future updates for a specific time. Go to Settings > Vehicle > Updates on the center display to manage the settings. NOTES - The vehicle notifies you before any update is installed. - The vehicle waits at least eight hours between the software download and installation to ensure you are aware the update is scheduled.

features.title: Improved Google Maps Search
features.description: We improved the quality of our Google power search results in the Navigation app.

features.title: Additional Improvements
features.description: - With the Rivian mobile app version 2.10.0 or later, you can now use a trailer profile that you created in the vehicle center display to plan a towing trip. NOTE The app also offers a generic, "default" trailer profile that you can use if you don't have any custom trailers defined. - We enhanced the look of the turn signal indicators so they are more visible and easier to notice. Infotainment - Fixed an issue that caused the media panel to close after audio was paused. - Fixed an issue that caused the live camera view to freeze momentarily when you switched between day and night modes with the Camera app on the center display and the vehicle in Reverse. Climate - Improved vent positions to more consistently save and restore them after the vehicle sleeps. - Improved performance of climate control in sunny conditions. - Fixed an issue that caused the rear window defrost setting to toggle rapidly. - Fixed a very rare issue that prevented the charge port door from opening. - Fixed an issue that made Vehicle Shipping mode text difficult to see in the title bar of the Vehicle > Service panel. - Improved proximity lock and unlock tuning for the iPhone® 15 Pro Max. - On Gen 1 Dual Motor standard pack vehicles, fixed an issue that prevented the High regen setting in Drive Modes > Brake Regen from appearing in the center display. - On a subset of Gen 1 R1T Quad Motor early VINs, fixed an issue that displayed an incorrect range.

features.title: Charging Score
features.description: Now when you select a charging station in Navigation or in the Rivian mobile app 2.8.0 (or later), you'll see a charging score based on key factors such as success rate and time it takes to start charging. Trip plans will automatically take these charging scores into account (where they're available) to help you avoid sites with lower scores. You can also adjust your charging map filters to hide sites with low scores.

features.title: Send Navigation, Mapping, and Charging Feedback
features.description: Also in Navigation, you now have an option to send feedback to us on any navigation, mapping, and charging issues. Go to the feedback icon to submit your comments.

features.title: Rear Display Improvements
features.description: We updated the rear display with a new layout, and added more functionality that includes access to: - Navigation trip progress - Power outlet controls - Media panel to view what's currently playing and the ability to play or pause - Rear vent and seat heat controls - Hotspot connection - Bluetooth connection - Interior lights control You can also now lock the rear display screen via a quick control in the center display.

features.description: Improved Pet Comfort temperature control by increasing the amount of airflow in the cabin. Improved ride height adjustments to reduce the number of occasions that require the vehicle to raise before a drive. Other - In Navigation, improved the swipe down behavior of the turn-by-turn instruction panel to make it easier to open while driving. - Fixed a rare issue that prevented Gear Guard from starting up and capturing video when the Motion Cam was turned on through the Rivian mobile app. - Fixed a rare issue that disabled Hotspot. - Fixed a rare issue that caused software package downloads to fail when the vehicle was connected to Wi-Fi. - Fixed an issue that caused a charge session to stop earlier than expected when state of charge (SoC) limit was set to 50%. - Fixed a rare issue during vehicle unlocking that prevented one or more of the door handles from presenting and mirrors from unfolding. - Fixed a very rare issue during vehicle wake that caused an incorrect alert to appear that said the Gear Tunnel door was open when it wasn't. - Fixed a rare issue that caused the vehicle to lock unexpectedly when the key fob or phone key was inside. - Improved the lock behavior to prevent lock out when the driver door is open, you lock the vehicle from the center display, exit the vehicle, and close the door. features.title: New Rivian Assistant
features.description: Rivian Assistant is now available on the R2 vehicle. Use the AI-powered, in-vehicle Rivian Assistant to help with the following: Control vehicle settings, climate control, navigation, media, messaging and calling. Reference the Owner's Guide with your voice. Answer general knowledge or follow-up questions. You can ask about local restaurants, the weather at your destination, or the song that was just played. Explain in-vehicle alerts or notifications or walk you through troubleshooting steps for vehicle concerns. How to Use To use Rivian Assistant, complete the first-time setup on the center display. To activate Rivian Assistant: On the steering wheel, push in the right Haptic Halo Wheel. Tap Rivian Assistant ⠀ in the status bar on the center display. Say "Okay, Rivian," or “Hey, Rivian.” To stop a command or interaction, tap the Rivian Assistant wave graphic on the center display. To learn more about Rivian Assistant, ask it about what it can do. To opt out or deactivate the wake words, go to Settings > Rivian Assistant on the center display. For more information, go to the Owner's Guide and search for Rivian Assistant. How to Personalize In the Rivian mobile app version 3.17 or later, you can personalize your Rivian Assistant experience through Rivian Intelligence. Go to Account > Rivian Intelligence to turn on these features: Google Calendars: Connect your calendars (from the same Gmail account) so you can create, re-schedule, or navigate to events using Rivian Assistant. Gmail integration: Rivian Assistant now connects with Gmail, so you can read, search, and get summaries of your emails hands-free while driving. To link your Gmail account, go to Rivian Intelligence in the Rivian mobile app. You can also view your connected account from the center display in your vehicle. Memory: Rivian Assistant learns your preferences over time, such as favorite music genres, restaurants, and regular destinations, including work or school drop-off locations. You can turn off Memory or delete the stored details at any time. NOTES The mobile app saves the Rivian Intelligence settings to your driver profile and applies them to any Rivian vehicle you drive. Rivian Assistant is available on vehicles that are actively subscribed to Connect+ or are in a trial period. Rivian Assistant is only available in English. Google Calendar and Memory are turned off by default. Opt in to use these features.

features.title: Navigation Improvements
features.description: We improved Navigation by adding the following: You can now name and re-order your saved locations, which you access through the Favorites menu or Rivian Assistant. The charger category search now uses the same charger filters and pins as the map of charging stations . Sites that may require multiple plug-ins for a successful charge now appear with lower charging scores. Where possible, charging scores also factor in your vehicle’s specific charge port type. Electric Era now appears as a fast-charging network across 16 states, located at retail locations such as Chevron, Costco, and Love's.

features.title: Programmable Liftgate Height
features.description: You can now set a custom opening height for the powered liftgate, which is useful when a garage has a low ceiling or when the vehicle is carrying a bike rack. To set the custom height: Open the liftgate to the height you want, and then press and hold the liftgate button to pause it. Press and hold the interior liftgate button for three seconds until the vehicle plays a chime and flashes the hazard lights once. To reset the liftgate height: Open the liftgate. Wait for it to reach its programmed height. Press and hold the interior liftgate button for three seconds. The vehicle plays two chimes and flashes the hazard lights twice to confirm the height is reset. For more information, go to the Owner's Guide and search for powered liftgate.

features.title: Pet Comfort: New Mobile App Controls and Pet Cam
features.description: Now you can use the Rivian mobile app version 3.17 or later to turn Pet Comfort on or off when you’re away from your vehicle. (All models) The Pet Cam view lets you check in on your pet from the app while Pet Comfort is active and live streaming is available. (Now available on R2) NOTES Pet Cam requires an active Connect+ subscription. If someone is inside the cabin and Pet Cam is live streaming, the center display provides an option to turn off live streaming and protect privacy.

features.title: Rivian Assistant Improvements
features.description: Secondary Google Calendar support: Rivian Assistant now has access to events from more than just your primary Google Calendar. If your linked Google account includes other calendars, like a family calendar, a shared team calendar, or a holiday calendar, you can choose which ones Rivian Assistant references when you ask about your schedule. To add a secondary calendar, go to Rivian Intelligence in the Rivian mobile app. Gmail integration: Rivian Assistant now connects with Gmail, so you can read, search, and get summaries of your emails hands-free while driving. To link your Gmail account, go to Rivian Intelligence in the Rivian mobile app. You can also view your connected account from the center display in your vehicle. Contact disambiguation: When you ask Rivian Assistant to call or message someone who shares a name with another contact or has multiple saved numbers, it now shows you a quick list to choose from on the center display instead of walking you through several spoken confirmations.
